headline: EPS falls sequentially, up sharply y/y
summary_short: Ishikawa Seisakusho reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥36.61, up 45.2% y/y from ¥25.22.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥36.61 rose 45.2% year-over-year from ¥25.22, but fell 23.2% sequentially from ¥47.68 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
